text: レッドも　まけずに　ポケモンを　たたかわせて　そだてると　いいぞ！

structure.jp: ポケモンを　たたかわせて
そだてると　いいぞ！

patterns.name: 〜ずに
patterns.explanation: ずに after a verb means 'without doing' it; it is a slightly bookish way to say ないで. まけずに = 'without losing', so 'don't be outdone'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: Changing たたかう to たたかわせる means making someone else do the fighting. The て ending then joins it to the next action. ポケモンをたたかわせて = 'make your Pokémon fight and'.

patterns.name: 〜といい
patterns.explanation: A verb followed by といい is a friendly piece of advice: it would be good to do this. そだてるといい = 'you should raise it'.
